name: Roger Marshall
summary:
Roger Wayne Marshall (born August 9, 1960) is an American politician and physician serving as the junior United States senator from Kansas, a seat he has held since 2021. A member of the Republican Party, he served as the U.S. representative for Kansas's 1st congressional district from 2017 until 2021.
Marshall practiced medicine as an obstetrician for more than 25 years before being elected to Congress in 2016.
